title: 审计日志触发器实战：三事件留痕 + 与业务事务同回滚（sqlite 实跑）
expected_output:
--- 业务提交后: 三条 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE + 一次等值更新未留痕 ---
  seq=1 emp_id=1 INSERT old=NULL  new=6000 
  seq=2 emp_id=2 INSERT old=NULL  new=8000 
  seq=3 emp_id=2 UPDATE old=8000  new=9000 
  seq=4 emp_id=1 DELETE old=6000  new=NULL 

=== 一致性验证（审计与业务同事务）===
  回滚前审计条数 = 5（含本次 UPDATE 留痕）
  回滚后审计条数 = 4
  审计与业务一起回滚: True
  回滚后 Bob 的工资 = 9000（业务也回到 9000）

工程要点: 审计表不设外键 / 等值更新不留痕 / 审计写入与业务同事务(原子)。
code:
import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=None)   # autocommit, 手动控制事务
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE emp(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE salary_audit(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                          emp_id INT, op TEXT, old_salary INT, new_salary INT);
-- 审计表故意不建外键: 否则删员工时会受参照完整性牵连
CREATE TRIGGER trg_emp_ai AFTER INSERT ON emp
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO salary_audit(emp_id,op,old_salary,new_salary)
  VALUES(NEW.id, 'INSERT', NULL, NEW.salary);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_emp_au AFTER UPDATE ON emp
WHEN NEW.salary <> OLD.salary        -- ECA 的 C(Condition): 等值更新不留痕
                                     -- (MySQL 写法: BEGIN IF NEW.salary <> OLD.salary THEN ... END IF; END)
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO salary_audit(emp_id,op,old_salary,new_salary)
  VALUES(OLD.id, 'UPDATE', OLD.salary, NEW.salary);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_emp_ad AFTER DELETE ON emp
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO salary_audit(emp_id,op,old_salary,new_salary)
  VALUES(OLD.id, 'DELETE', OLD.salary, NULL);
END;
""")

def show_log(title):
    print("--- %s ---" % title)
    for r in con.execute("SELECT seq, emp_id, op, old_salary, new_salary FROM salary_audit ORDER BY seq"):
        print("  seq=%d emp_id=%d %-6s old=%-5s new=%-5s"
              % (r[0], r[1], r[2], "NULL" if r[3] is None else r[3],
                 "NULL" if r[4] is None else r[4]))

con.execute("BEGIN")
con.execute("INSERT INTO emp VALUES(1, 'Alice', 6000)")
con.execute("INSERT INTO emp VALUES(2, 'Bob',   8000)")
con.execute("UPDATE emp SET salary = 9000 WHERE id = 2")
con.execute("UPDATE emp SET salary = 9000 WHERE id = 2")     # 等值更新, 不留痕
con.execute("DELETE FROM emp WHERE id = 1")
con.execute("COMMIT")
show_log("业务提交后: 三条 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE + 一次等值更新未留痕")

# 关键: 触发器写入与业务写入共享同一事务 -> 业务回滚时审计一并回滚
con.execute("BEGIN")
con.execute("UPDATE emp SET salary = 1 WHERE id = 2")
n_before = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salary_audit").fetchone()[0]
con.execute("ROLLBACK")
n_after = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM salary_audit").fetchone()[0]
print()
print("=== 一致性验证（审计与业务同事务）===")
print("  回滚前审计条数 = %d（含本次 UPDATE 留痕）" % n_before)
print("  回滚后审计条数 = %d" % n_after)
print("  审计与业务一起回滚: %s" % (n_before == n_after + 1))
print("  回滚后 Bob 的工资 = %d（业务也回到 9000）"
      % con.execute("SELECT salary FROM emp WHERE id = 2").fetchone()[0])
print()
print("工程要点: 审计表不设外键 / 等值更新不留痕 / 审计写入与业务同事务(原子)。")
